title: What Happens When Necrozma Can't Absorb Light?
premise: Necrozma's survival hinges on absorbing light, but what occurs if it's deprived of this vital energy source?
audiencePromise: Explain the mysterious consequences when Necrozma is deprived of light.
openLoop: What happens to Necrozma if it doesn't get any light?
payoff: Deprived of light, Necrozma darkens, impurities build, and it stops moving altogether.
engagementQuestion: Do you think Necrozma should roam free or be contained?

voice.instructions: Intriguing and mysterious, with a sense of building tension.

scenes.headline: WHAT HAPPENS IN THE DARK?
scenes.narration: What if Necrozma doesn’t get any light?
scenes.caption: NECROZMA IN DARKNESS

scenes.headline: NECROZMA HUNGERS FOR LIGHT
scenes.narration: Light is not just energy—it's survival for Necrozma.
scenes.caption: WITHOUT LIGHT, LIFE CEASES

scenes.headline: IMPURITIES PILE UP
scenes.narration: Without light, impurities build within and on Necrozma.
scenes.caption: WITHOUT LIGHT, DARKNESS SPREADS

scenes.headline: IT STOPS MOVING
scenes.narration: Eventually, Necrozma darkens and becomes immobile.
scenes.caption: MOTIONLESS IN DARK

scenes.headline: LIGHT-SEEKING RAMPAGE
scenes.narration: In its desperation, Necrozma goes on a rampage, destroying for light.
scenes.caption: SEEKING LIGHT AT ALL COSTS

scenes.headline: FREE OR CONTAIN?
scenes.narration: Do you think Necrozma should roam free or be contained?
scenes.caption: NECROZMA'S FATE IN YOUR HANDS
